 Christina Applegate says she was misdiagnosed with MS 
 4:11 Christina Applegate reveals multiple sclerosis diagnosis Matt Winkelmeyer/Getty Images By Yi-Jin Yu October 20, 2026, 8:26 AM 
 Actress Christina Applegate says she was misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis (MS), a neurological and autoimmune disorder.
 "It's hard to say that [my doctor] came into my room and she said, 'Congratulations! You don't have MS,'" Applegate said on Tuesday's episode of MeSsY, her podcast with co-host Jamie Lynn Sigler.
 Applegate first revealed on social media in 2021 that she was diagnosed with MS .
